result.summary: No critical breakage found. Found 2 visual issues: a spelling typo in the main search placeholder and clipped carousel content on the right edge.

issues.description: Search bar placeholder reads 'Restarants, dishes, groceries' - 'Restaurants' is misspelled.
issues.suggestion: Correct placeholder text to 'Restaurants, dishes, groceries'.

issues.description: Third card in 'Fastest near you' row shows truncated name 'Trattoria Piccol' clipped mid-letter at the right screen edge.
issues.suggestion: Add proper end padding / carousel peek spacing so cards are not cut mid-character and scrolling is clearly indicated.
